title: Continuous-time Online Learning via Mean-Field Neural Networks: Regret Analysis in Diffusion Environments
summary: We study continuous-time online learning where data are generated by a diffusion process with unknown coefficients. The learner employs a two-layer neural network, continuously updating its parameters in a non-anticipative manner. The mean-field limit of the learning dynamics corresponds to a stochastic Wasserstein gradient flow adapted to the data filtration. We establish regret bounds for both the mean-field limit and finite-particle system. Our analysis leverages the logarithmic Sobolev inequality, Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition, Malliavin calculus, and uniform-in-time propagation of chaos.…
